title: Rainbow Island Adventure
moral: Helping others and sharing makes adventures special.

scenes.summary: Captain Rosie sets out to find treasure on Rainbow Island.
scenes.text: Captain Rosie sailed her ship with her crew to find the Lost Treasure of Rainbow Island.
scenes.image_prompt: girl pirate captain with parrot sailing ship toward rainbow island cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Rosie sailed her ship to find treasure on Rainbow Island. A storm came, but she stayed brave and guided her crew safely. On the island, they helped a lost sailor named Sam before finding treasure. Inside the chest were jewels and a book of stories. They returned home happy, knowing kindness and friendship matter most.
